name: ai-act-plugin
description: AI Act compliance for a codebase (Reg. UE 2024/1689 as amended by Reg. UE 2026/1744 — 'Digital Omnibus IA'). The /ai-act command scans the code for AI components, classifies risk and provider/deployer role, lists obligations with post-Digital-Omnibus deadlines, generates the constraint rules the agents follow, and produces client- and end-user-facing deliverables — every legal statement grounded in the ai-act-check skill and its references/, never from memory. Five modes: scan, rules, docs, gate, status.
